               routable_subnets = [s.strip() for s in str(subnet).split('\n') if s.strip()]
           clean = subnet_re.sub('', desc).strip()
           if not clean:
               clean = desc
           rows_out.append((sitecode, int(vid), clean, desc, ';'.join(routable_subnets)))

   with open('/tmp/vlan_plan.csv','w',newline='') as f:
       w = csv.writer(f, delimiter=';')
       w.writerow(['site','vid','name','description','subnets'])
       w.writerows(rows_out)

   for r in rows_out:
       print(r)
